# Gold's Gym Iloilo

> Official website of Gold's Gym Iloilo — a modern fitness gym in Iloilo City located at Saint Honore, Iloilo Business Park, Mandurriao, featuring Gym80 strength equipment, four dedicated training zones, covered parking, and competitive personal coaches.

## Key Facts

- **Website:** https://www.goldsgym-iloilo.com
- **Location:** Saint Honore, G/F – Unit A-1A-5, Iloilo Business Park, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, 5000 Iloilo, Philippines
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Saint+Honore+Iloilo+Business+Park+Mandurriao+Iloilo+City
- **Opening Hours (PHT / Asia/Manila):**
  - Monday – Friday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM
  - Saturday – Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- **Phone / SMS:** 0917 327 5902 (+63 917 327 5902)
- **Email:** goldsgymiloilo.management@gmail.com
- **Membership & Day Pass Inquiries:** Rates are not published online; visitors can contact the front desk by phone, SMS, or email to inquire about a free day pass, membership options, or to schedule a visit.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.goldsgym-iloilo.com/): Overview of Gold's Gym Iloilo, live opening hours, location, training floor gallery, and contact drawer.
- [Why Gold's Gym](https://www.goldsgym-iloilo.com/why-gold-s-gym): Detailed breakdown of all four training zones (Free Weights, Gym80 Strength, Cardio Bay, Functional Training) and gym amenities including covered parking and the heritage lounge.
- [Coaches](https://www.goldsgym-iloilo.com/coaches): Profiles, specializations, competition records, and certifications of the Gold's Gym Iloilo coaching team.
- [Reviews & FAQ](https://www.goldsgym-iloilo.com/reviews-faq): Verified five-star Google reviews from members and answers to first-visit questions.

## Training Zones & Facilities

- **Free Weights:** Dedicated free-weight setup for presses, pulls, squats, rows, and foundational strength training.
- **Gym80 Strength:** German-engineered Gym80 strength machines designed for controlled, focused resistance training.
- **Cardio Bay:** Treadmills, bikes, and cardio stations for warm-ups, steady-state conditioning, and endurance work.
- **Functional Training:** Open floor space for sled work, kettlebells, carries, and conditioning drills.
- **Amenities:** Clean & modern facilities, heritage lounge, and covered ground-floor parking bays with car and motorcycle slots at Saint Honore.

## Personal Trainers & Coaches

- **Andrew Miano (Fitness Coach):** Competitive Men's Physique athlete (1st Novice & 2nd Open, Mr. Iloilo Men's Physique 2023; IFBB Philippines Bodybuilding Open Men's Physique 2025). Specializes in Strength Training, Conditioning, Competition Prep, Weight Loss / Toning, Supplement Guide, 1-on-1 Training, Boxing & Circuit, and Personalized Workout Programs. Certifications: Red Cross First Aider Certificate, Batang Hipe Certificate, IFA Academy Certificate.
- **Vincent Loui Dorde (Fitness Coach):** Competitive physique athlete (5th Place Mr. Fit Man Code · Get Wheysted Bacolod 2024; 2nd Place Men's Physique Novice Class B & 4th Place Open Class C, AGP 2026; 3rd Place Classic Physique Open Class B, AGP 2026). Specializes in Strength & Conditioning, Nutrition Planning, Competition Prep, Body Transformation, and Weight Loss.
- **Jerry Perje (Fitness Coach):** Competitive physique athlete (Champion Men's Physique Open, KG Classic 2023; 5th Place Men's Physique Open Class B, AGP 2026; 6th Place Classic Physique Open Class B, AGP 2026). Specializes in Strength & Conditioning, Competition Prep, Weight Loss, Muscle Hypertrophy, and Body Transformation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Do I need to book?** Visitors can contact the team through the website, or call/text 0917 327 5902 to confirm a visit or inquire about a free day pass.
- **What should I bring?** Comfortable workout clothes, training shoes, water, and a towel.
- **Can I just look around?** Yes — visitors are welcome to drop by and see the floor (Free Weights, Gym80 Strength, Cardio Bay, and Functional Training).
- **Is there parking?** Yes — convenient covered ground-floor parking is available right under Saint Honore at Iloilo Business Park.
- **What happens after my first visit?** Visitors can ask the front desk or email goldsgymiloilo.management@gmail.com / call 0917 327 5902 for current membership rates and options.
